newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Oct industrial output rises 10.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Oct industrial output rises 10.8 pct.

text.p: South Korea's industrial output in October rose 10.8 percent year-on-year against a 9.9 percent rise a year earlier, provisional National Statistical Office (NSO) said on Friday.
Note: figures in percent, year-on-year change.
The NSO figures showed industrial output rose 3.2 percent in October from September, against a 0.5 percent fall a year ago.
Heady output growth in October was due largely to fewer holidays in the month and a recovery in sales of vehicles and oil products.
The NSO said output of vehicles and oil products in October rose 16.9 percent and 23.5 percent year-on-year, respectively.

Output of heavy industrial goods in October rose year-on-year 14.8 percent against a 13.0 percent rise a year ago, while that of light industrial goods fell 2.5 percent, against a fall of 0.3 percent.
The NSO figures showed ex-factory shipments for exports in the month increased year-on-year 12.6 percent, against a 19.8 percent rise a year before.
Delivery to the domestic market rose 10.1 percent, compared with a rise of 6.7 percent a year ago.
